owner_decision: Root explicitly chose a new prebound_paid_pair allocation scope; this does not change historical free-unit runtime scope or old qualification gates.

controller.identity_creator: Trusted Host reserve coordinator before submitting the two budgeted production commands
controller.controller_id: Fresh UUID4 for this controller lifecycle
controller.lease_id: UUID5(controller_id, lease); fixed before first borrow, never replaced by a later model task UUID
controller.production_references: Two predeclared producer command/task UUIDs plus seq, unit hash, actual expected cost, factory identity; object/object_id initially zero until real receipt discovery
controller.tactical_channel: Claim the 17-hook tactical channel before install; old MCT7 or other tactical DLL cannot start while controller remains active, including the period without a model task. The existing disjoint five-hook production controller can remain running.

timing.deadline_freeze: Before first real borrow, immutable across role arrival, model response, mission commit, hidden target and retry
timing.startup_without_borrow: Separate bounded startup timeout; no indefinite controller waiting

paid_scope.name: prebound_paid_pair
paid_scope.required_payment_proof: Each role has its own exact paid/created/completed producer receipt and current real Native admission; no forged army denominator or free-unit eligibility
paid_scope.fraction_meaning: Use the complete exact pair under this already frozen lease. It is a fraction of this real paid pair, not a fraction of the entire free army.
paid_scope.denominator: The same two real paid bound actors; partial pair, extra actor or another lease cannot be selected
paid_scope.strategy_accounting: A trusted purpose/formation-specific pair allowance must be separate from the old free-army fractional allowance. Current BattleAgent passes cap=1-plan.reserve to Goals.reconcile; without a dedicated scoped branch, force_fraction=1 is blocked before client dispatch. Preserve ordinary spend and old free force accounting; never rewrite the model fraction into an invented smaller value.

slot_admission.source: Existing running production mapping, read-only, actual magic 0x50434d44/version1, Header256/Receipt224
slot_admission.proof: Stable receipt updates0/version/raw twice, immutable payment/object projection frozen, dynamic live/version/HP/XY allowed as actual historical samples. running_birth_source_v1 is provenance only and cannot replace Native current own actor/ground/health/stance/team checks.
slot_admission.sequence: As each original paid role becomes actual and completes its real three-frame admission, the same controller borrows it immediately; do not wait until both are free in a Python snapshot.
slot_admission.ready: Each bound slot must pass its actual Stop3/stance/ownership readiness and remain under observed controller control; record exact waiting duration, gaps, drift, path/state, lifecycle and cleanup.
slot_admission.ninety_frame_rule: Do not mechanically require both slots to repeat a 90-frame single-actor calibration hold. The old 90-frame primitive gates and old raw reports stay unchanged. MF13 is a distinct mission protocol and needs its own exact real readiness/holding/approach/effect/retreat/release Source evidence.
slot_admission.failure: Wrong/missing receipt, loss of control, dead actor, unsafe state or deadline causes ordinary cleanup of every held slot. No substitute actor, renewed deadline or Return/reborrow race.

public_formation.id: Opaque formation_ + stable UUID5(controller_id, paid_pair) prefix
public_formation.show_only_when: Both actual roles are admitted and under real controller ownership; only then may the exact pair be offered for model assignment. Never describe future expected units as present.
public_formation.scope_visibility: Trusted model capability manifest explains coordinate_force covers this complete prebound pair with request_force_fraction=1; no controller IDs, native addresses, SDK entry points or coordinates enter model output.
public_formation.free_exclusion: From first slot admission, claim each held ID in controller claim registry and executor reservation set, exclude it from old free formations regardless of apparent team; legacy submit rejects it. Registry refresh must preserve the dedicated private held formation rather than overwrite it.
public_formation.on_task_commit: The same public formation/version becomes unavailable to new jobs; existing mission context retains it through completion and plan refresh.

model_mission_commit.task_id_creator: Existing Goals/BattleAgent creates the model task UUID only after a real accepted plan selects the visible eligible formation and legal target
model_mission_commit.command_id_creator: TacticalBridge creates the parent command UUID and monotonic sequence immediately before exactly-once commit
model_mission_commit.child_identity: Preserve UUID5(parent command, formation) and UUID5(model task, formation) normal child mapping, recorded in a new MissionCommit block separate from immutable outer controller/lease identity
ordered_steps: Persist controller/lease to task/command/formation mapping and exact bound actor allocation
Reserve the public formation and commit persistent agent mission with the original controller hard deadline divided by 15
Publish the one MissionCommit block to the existing controller; do not spawn another DLL/host or Transfer/Return actors
Native independently verifies current ownership, readiness, budget scope, fresh player FOV, target identity, original deadlines and single-commit state
Native ACK is telemetry only. Actual approach/effect/physical retreat and final restoration are independently requalified from raw observations
model_mission_commit.write_once: Empty -> published -> accepted/rejected, one exact digest. An identical repeated observation may read the existing ACK; conflicting/replacement targets, changed IDs, extra actors or any deadline extension are rejected. An ambiguous commit is never retried as a fresh command.
model_mission_commit.no_model_choice: No legal model choice/target or timeout requires normal cleanup at the existing deadline; controller must not invent an attack or silently repurpose itself.

decision_trigger.event: Trusted controller pair-ready/commit-eligible edge plus currently verified visible valid target
decision_trigger.required_small_extension: A once-per-verified-controller-epoch urgent capability request cancels and awaits obsolete pending model work, refreshes the snapshot, bypasses the old 2/15-second minimum hold for that epoch, and issues at most one request at a time. Repeated polls do not trigger repeated network calls.
decision_trigger.stale_response: Reject if controller/formation version/ownership/target visibility/deadline changed; no effects credited merely for accepted plan or published commit.
decision_trigger.deadline: If insufficient real time remains for the bounded request and validation, cleanup under the existing reserve deadline rather than extend it.

audit.two_clocks: Preserve actual lease_issued_frame (may precede model task dispatch) separately from actual mission_commit/approach frame. Do not relabel early borrow as a model-directed issue. New MF13 bound_report must verify outer lease and the actual write-once MissionCommit child identity.
audit.untasked_controllers: Every controller, even if no model task ever exists, has a persisted terminal/release audit covering all held roles and the occupied channel. No untasked lease can disappear from the model-only task ledger.
audit.public_progress: Reserve startup/slot waiting remains private raw telemetry. Publish standard continuous mission progress once actual approach starts; keep existing mission phase monotonicity and do not weaken reserved-self-loop validation.
audit.success: Actual same-match approach, role coordination, damage and physical retreat/release must pass independent raw qualification. Full model match also requires actual accepted post-original-plan-TTL compressed mission context and natural native settlement.

integration/tactical_bridge.py: exact controller route, frozen expiry, task mapping, reuse same host
tactical/client.py: special prebound-pair submit/status/retreat/release and explicit cap1 scope; old free branches stay .5
strategy/battle_agent.py and strategy/engine.py: trusted purpose-specific pair accounting/capability manifest and one-shot urgent epoch, keeping model output and Formation five-field schemas
tactical/evidence.py and integration/continuous_evidence.py: new scope/pins and real controller+MissionCommit binding
whole-match audit: untasked controller cleanup and task-linked lease intervals
